lines.text: The LORD says He will put His Spirit on His Chosen Servant, who will bring justice to the nations.
The Servant will not cry out in the streets, and a bruised reed He will not break.
He will not grow weak before He establishes justice on earth, and the mountains will hope in His law.
God the LORD, who spread out the earth, appoints the one He called as a light to the rulers.
The LORD will not yield His glory to another or His praise to idols, and He declares new things.
